rows.text: Ministry of Home Affairs notification No. 10/5/96-M&G of 24 May 1996: the President has been pleased to appoint Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee to be the Prime Minister with effect from 12 P.M. (noon) of 16 May 1996; the next paragraph appoints the members of the Council of Ministers, on the advice of the Prime Minister, from the same time.

locator.item: Ministry of Home Affairs Notification No. 10/5/96-M & G, New Delhi, the 24th May, 1996 (Hindi and English on page 1); signed V. K. Malhotra, Jt. Secy. (page 2)
